summary.caption: Museum-quality speculative zoology plate documenting four related cloud-forest creatures, warm natural-history paper, precise graphite and watercolour rendering, turquoise scientific accents, shared anatomy language and refined contemporary field-guide design.

items.label: text
items.caption: Elegant charcoal scientific plate title across the top.

items.label: character
items.caption: Upper-left specimen: a small six-legged gliding mammal with translucent leaf-shaped ears, moss-green fur and a long balancing tail, side profile.

items.label: character
items.caption: Upper-right specimen: a tall gentle browsing creature with the same leaf-shaped ears, elongated neck, moss-green coat and turquoise throat markings, side profile.

items.label: character
items.caption: Lower-left specimen: a compact armoured burrowing relative with overlapping bark-like plates, six sturdy legs and turquoise sensory whiskers, three-quarter view.

items.label: character
items.caption: Lower-right specimen: a graceful airborne relative with four broad translucent wings, moss-green body and a luminous turquoise tail fan, wings fully spread.
